subject.title: sessions_send coordinators never receive state-change notices for non-spawned targets

question: Should `sessions_send` expose an opt-in durable watch for authorized peer sessions?
rationale: The missing behavior and implementation boundary are clear, but this adds model-facing tool surface and extends proactive coordination beyond the approved spawn-lineage design.

options.title: Approve narrow peer watches
options.body: Add `watch: true` only after existing visibility and A2A authorization, without automatic watches or broader hierarchy behavior.

options.title: Keep peer polling
options.body: Retain proactive notices only for spawn lineage and require peer coordinators to reconcile through `stateVersion` and `session_status`.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow peer watches
recommendation.body: Add `watch: true` only after existing visibility and A2A authorization, without automatic watches or broader hierarchy behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current signal-log design and have the strongest history on the affected session tool.
